translations.web: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
translations.bsb: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
translations.kjv: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
translations.asv: They are all gone aside; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
